# [Curve Dental](https://www.curvedental.com/)

Curve Dental is a fresh, web-based alternative to dental software and a leading provider of SaaS Clinical and Practice Management software for the North American dental market. These solutions provide dentists with clinical (charting and imaging) and practice management (scheduling, billing and engagement) tools.
